name: Super V Clipboard
description:
Windows-style clipboard history for GNOME. Press Super+V to see what you copied and click an item to paste it. Unpinned items are deleted automatically after a time you choose (30 minutes by default); pinned items are kept.

Clipboard access: this extension reads the clipboard to build the history. The history stays in memory on your computer and is never sent anywhere. Only pinned items are saved to disk (~/.local/share/superv-clipboard, readable only by you). Copies marked secret by password managers are skipped, and nothing is recorded while the screen is locked.
